description.en: The ID of the database file system.

description.zh: 扩容后的数据库文件系统容量，必须大于扩容前的数据库文件系统容量。单位GiB。
description.en: The capacity of the database file system after resizing. It must be greater than its capacity before resizing. Unit: GiB.

description.zh: DBFS实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the DBFS instance. Call [DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html) to view the latest Alibaba Cloud regions.

descriptions.zh:
- 扩容后的数据库文件系统容量必须大于扩容前的容量。

- 数据库文件系统的状态必须为已挂载（attached）。
descriptions.en:
- The new capacity of the DBFS must be greater than its current capacity.

- The DBFS must be in the attached state.
